title: EssentialsConfig
description: Root Essentials configuration file, backed by EssentialsConfig (EssentialsConfig.cs), which extends BasicConfig (BasicConfig.cs).

devices.description: The list of devices (including plugin devices and rooms) to instantiate. Each plugin publishes its own schema for the shape of its "properties" object.

sourceLists.description: Named lists of source list items, keyed by list name then item key.

destinationLists.description: Named lists of destination list items, keyed by list name then item key.

audioControlPointLists.description: Named audio control point lists, keyed by list name.

cameraLists.description: Named lists of camera list items, keyed by list name then item key.

tieLines.description: Static tie lines between routing ports.

joinMaps.description: Join map override data, keyed by device/room key. Structure is join-map-specific and not further constrained here.

system_url.description: The System URL used to derive systemUuid.

template_url.description: The Template URL used to derive templateUuid.

systemUuid.description: Computed from system_url. Not intended to be authored directly.

templateUuid.description: Computed from template_url. Not intended to be authored directly.

rooms.description: The list of room devices for this system, using the same device-entry shape as "devices".

deviceConfigEntry.description: Generic device config entry (DeviceConfig.cs). Each plugin defines its own schema for the shape of "properties" for a given "type".

key.description: Unique identifier for this device within the configuration file.

name.description: Friendly display name for this device.

type.description: Discriminator identifying the plugin factory that instantiates this device.

properties.description: Type-specific properties object; see the owning plugin's schema for its shape.

infoConfig.description: The info section of a config file (InfoConfig.cs).

hostname.description: Populated from the processor at runtime.

appNumber.description: Populated from the processor at runtime.

runtimeInfo.description: Runtime information about the program/processor (InfoConfig.cs). Populated at runtime; not intended to be authored.

versionData.description: Version data for Essentials and its packages (VersionData in EssentialsConfig.cs).

packageVersion.description: A named package/version pair (PackageVersion in EssentialsConfig.cs).

sourceListItem.description: An item in a source list (SourceListItem.cs).

sourceKey.description: Key of the source device in the DeviceManager.

preferredName.description: Computed from name or the source device's name.

name.description: A name that will override the source's name on the UI.

volumeControlKey.description: The key of the device for volume control.

disableCodecSharing.description: Disable sharing this source to far-end call participants via codec content.

sourceRouteListItem.description: A route to execute for a source list item (SourceRouteListItem in SourceListItem.cs).

type.description: Signal type being routed. Flags enum; combinations may be comma-separated. Case-insensitive.

destinationListItemKey.description: If set together with sourceListItemKey, the direct route method is used.

sourceListItemKey.description: If set together with destinationListItemKey, the direct route method is used.

destinationListItem.description: A destination item in a routing system (DestinationListItem.cs).

sinkKey.description: Key of the sink device that this destination represents.

preferredName.description: Computed from name or the sink device's name.

sinkType.description: Signal type this destination can receive. Flags enum; combinations may be comma-separated. Case-insensitive.

cameraListItem.description: An item in a camera list (CameraListItem.cs).

deviceKey.description: Key of the camera device in the DeviceManager.

preferredName.description: Computed from name or the camera device's name.

audioControlPointListItem.description: A named audio control point list containing level controls and presets (AudioControlPointListItem.cs).

audioControlListItemBase.description: Common fields shared by level control and preset list items (AudioControlListItemBase.cs).

parentDeviceKey.description: Key of the parent device in the DeviceManager.

itemKey.description: Optional key of the item within the parent device.

levelControlListItem.description: A level/mute control item in an audio control point list (LevelControlListItem.cs).

preferredName.description: Computed from name or the underlying device's name.

deviceKey.description: Computed from parentDeviceKey/itemKey; not intended to be authored.

type.description: Flags enum indicating whether this item is a level control, mute control, or both. Case-insensitive.

isMic.description: Indicates if this item represents a microphone.

presetListItem.description: A preset item in an audio control point list (PresetListItem.cs).

preferredName.description: Computed from name or the underlying preset's name.

tieLineConfig.description: A static tie line between two routing ports (TieLineConfig.cs).

SourceCard.description: Key of the source card, if applicable (e.g. in a modular chassis).

type.description: Optional override for the signal type of the tie line. Flags enum; combinations may be comma-separated. Case-insensitive.
